title: Classroom & Study Language
subtitle: The words you'll see on this website, in every lesson, from now on.
objectives: Understand common exercise instructions like "fill in the blank" and "choose the correct answer"
Ask for help when you don't understand something
Ask how to say a word in English

content.intro: Before going further, let's learn the words this website itself uses all the time. Once you know these, every future lesson will be easier to follow.

rules.heading: Instructions you'll see in every exercise
rules.body:
• Fill in the blank — write the missing word.
  • Choose the correct answer — pick one option.
  • Match — connect two things that go together.
  • Put the words in order — arrange words into a correct sentence.
  • Submit — click to check your answers.
  • Correct / Incorrect — right or wrong.

rules.heading: Asking for help
rules.body:
• I don't understand.
  • Can you repeat, please?
  • Can you explain that again?
  • How do you say [word in your language] in English?
  • What does [word] mean?
  • Can you spell that, please?

examples: I don't understand. Can you repeat, please?
How do you say "obrigado" in English?
Please fill in the blank with the correct word.
Choose the correct answer, then click Submit.

exercises.title: Match the Instruction to Its Meaning

items.explanation: These instructions appear on almost every exercise on this website.

items.prompt: You don't understand a word. What do you say?
items.explanation: "I don't understand" is the natural way to ask for help.

items.prompt: You want to know an English word for something. What do you ask?
options: How do you say this in English?
items.explanation: "How do you say [word] in English?" is the standard question.

exercises.title: Practice
exercises.instructions: Write, in English, how you would ask someone to repeat what they said.

items.prompt: Ask someone to repeat what they just said.

summary: Fill in the blank, choose the correct answer, match, and put the words in order are the four main exercise instructions on this site.
"I don't understand" and "Can you repeat, please?" are essential survival phrases.
"How do you say ___ in English?" lets you ask for any word you need.
